summary: Instagram at 7 followers (-2 in 7d) with 33 posts/30d but median engagement 0. LinkedIn growing (57 followers) but 0 posts/30d. Bio violates rules: names niches (hotels, cafes, gyms, homestays), region (Himachal), timeframe (24 hrs), and free offer outside website posts. Reels show 63-76% skip rates — first 3 seconds fail.
guidance:
- Hook: rotate to **top3 list** (1.5x) or **contrast** (1.44x) — avoid pure question hooks (0.97x angle, though question hook style 1.46x).
- Angle: **mistake** (1.3x, n=10) works best; **myth_bust** (1.25x) next. Stop repeating "why do customers call" / "WhatsApp enquiries end" — already used 3× in 2 weeks.
- Format: **carousel** beats reel (23% earnings per reach). Use **desk-glow** or **silhouette** image style.
- Service: **lead_gen** (1.62x) and **chatbot** (1.39x) outperform **website** (1.25x) — but today is website, so frame as a mistake/myth bust, not a pitch.
- Never read like an ad: show developer thinking, not selling. No demo claims, no niche targeting, no timeframes.

instructions.research: Find one common website mistake Indian small businesses make (e.g. missing WhatsApp link, no clear pricing, broken mobile menu) — cite a public example type, not a client.
instructions.analysis: Compare the last 3 website posts (Nov 14, 21, today) — all used question hooks. Confirm they got near-zero engagement; recommend switching to mistake/contrast hook for today.
instructions.writer: Write a carousel post: hook = top3 list of website mistakes that lose enquiries. Angle = mistake. No niche, no region, no price, no timeframe. End with 'pay after approval' + DM for honest fit check. Hinglish allowed.
instructions.image: Create 3-slide carousel: slide 1 = bold headline (top 3 mistakes), slides 2-4 = each mistake with silhouette/desk-glow code snippet or UI sketch. No logos, no client names. Text readable on mobile.
instructions.video: Skip reel today — carousel earns 4.3× more per reach. If video needed later, use retention-v2 structure but only after 3 carousels test better.
